policy_title: Negotiate Free and Simple Travel for Artists to the EU
stated: Negotiate free and simple short-term travel arrangements for UK artists to perform in the EU, and European artists to perform in the UK.

source.quote: Negotiate free and simple short-term travel arrangements for UK artists to perform in the EU, and European artists to perform in the UK.

bearing_set.reason: Post-Brexit work-permit and visa barriers directly reduce UK artists' ability to earn income through EU engagements; negotiating free short-term travel arrangements would materially improve job security, access to work, and pay for a significant professional cohort.

The creative industries are a major UK economic sector; removing bilateral travel friction would raise productivity, business dynamism and economic opportunity across touring, live events and associated supply chains.

membership_note: Policy bears on O4 (workers' conditions/income for artists) and O13 (aggregate sector prosperity/business dynamism). Effects on O10 (liberty) are incidental — this is a diplomatic facilitation not a coercive measure. O15 (cohesion) and O9 (equal treatment) effects are too indirect to clear the non-negligible bar. No material fiscal effect meriting O12.
